fomod.Name: Zone Bodycam
fomod.Author: Built for this GAMMA setup. Motion model after Sludge's Intrusive 3D Masks.
fomod.Description: Chest-mounted police bodycam: fisheye lens with chromatic aberration and sensor sharpening, body motion (turn lag, gait bob and roll, breathing, spring-damped impacts), and a live top-right overlay with in-game date and time, device line, character name and logo. The lens runs in the post chain after DLSS/FSR (Slop-Ray engine); the housing and overlay are procedural HUD layers drawn after frame generation. Everything is configurable in MCM.
